I Fits, I Sits

privacy

I Fits, I Sits: Cat Jump is made by Adam Goodwin. The game does not collect, sell or share any personal data.

  • No accounts. We don't ask for your name, email or contacts.
  • No ads, no analytics and no tracking.
  • Your progress (levels, stars, the closet and settings) is saved only on this device. Deleting the game deletes it.
  • Purchases go through Apple. We never see your payment details.
  • When you're online, the game checks our website for game updates. Nothing about you or your progress is sent. The site is hosted by GitHub Pages, which, like any web host, can see the IP address a request comes from; we don't receive or store it.
  • Apple's own "enjoying it?" rating box may appear now and then; the game doesn't see your answer.
  • The game is for general audiences and collects nothing from anyone, including children.

The full policy: maksidaa.github.io/if-i-fits-site/privacy.html · Apple's privacy policy: apple.com/legal/privacy

  • Play: touch anywhere and pull back to aim, let go to fling. Land a cat in every spot (the dashed boxes). Tap while a cat flies, or just after it lands, for its trick.
  • Stars: one for every spot filled, one for cats left over, one for enough mess. Worlds open as you earn stars.
  • Stuck? After a miss you can ask for 1 more cat. Lose a level twice and paw prints show a first throw that works. The rest is up to you.
  • Sound and vibration: in the pause card (the button at the top left during a level). The game plays sound even on silent.
  • The Whole Game: "restore purchase" on the level list restores it with the same Apple ID. Family Sharing works.
  • Your progress stays on this device; deleting the game deletes it.

Support and "report a problem": maksidaa.github.io/if-i-fits-site/support.html
